turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are you doing right now?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My flatmate's vegan and it's her birthday. I've never cooked without butter in my life.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's sweet of you. A mushroom stroganoff with cashew cream or a big chickpea curry would both feel special. Which way do you want to go?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Hang on, I'm going to chat with my friend for a bit. Just wait until I say I'm back.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Go ahead and use my charger, mine's in the drawer anyway.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Lucas, is that the dog's lead hanging on your bike?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Yeah, I took him round the park on the way back. He pulled the whole time.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: He does that with everyone but me. Did he stop at the pond?

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: Stop? He tried to swim in it. I had to drag him out by the harness.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: So that explains the smell in the hallway.

turns.speaker: friend
turns.text: I'll give him a bath tonight, promise.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Okay. So, her birthday dinner. Stroganoff or curry?
